infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Noah uses your camera to photograph book pages so it can pull out the words your child is learning.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Noah uses your photos to select book page images for word extraction.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Noah uses speech recognition to listen when your child reads words aloud.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Noah needs microphone access to hear your child read words during practice.
infoPlist.NSUserTrackingUsageDescription: Noah does not track you across other apps. Allowing this lets us measure how new readers find Noah so we can improve it.
